_comment: Scientific papers the client sent by e-mail on 2026-10-07 and the four ICARDA reports of 2020 sent on 2026-10-24, published as downloads under R&D + I > Scientific publications, after the articles that have their own page. Titles stay in the language they were published in, as cited works do elsewhere on the site; `source` is the authors and venue as printed on the document, `date` the date printed on it, `sortDate` the same date as YYYY-MM-DD so the list can be put in order (a season counts from its first autumn). To add one: drop the file in public/media/research/publications/ and add an entry below with `bytes` set to the file size.
